_doc: Tool paths for engine/audio (common.py) and engine/cli (lib/config.mjs). Relative paths are from the project root; empty = auto-detect. python: engine/.venv (setup.ps1), else research/audio/venvs/kokoro. ffmpeg/ffprobe: tools/bin/*.exe (setup.ps1 download), else PATH. hf_*: Kokoro/Whisper model caches (setup.ps1 -WithKokoro), else research/audio/dl/*.
